newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujitsu up as investors buy high-tech laggards.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu up as investors buy high-tech laggards.

text.p: Fujitsu Ltd shares advanced on Monday morning, as investors, especially foreigners, moved to buy laggard stocks in the high technology sector, brokers said.
As of 0057 GMT, the shares were up 20 yen at 1,220. Trade volume was 3.515 million shares, making Fujitsu the most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
The chipmaker said on Monday that it expects parent current profits of 120 billion yen in the business year starting on April 1, up 50 percent from its forecast of 80 billion yen for 1996/97.
"We have not yet finalised our forecast for the next business year, but this is what we basically expect," a company spokesman said.
Robust demand for computer networks for corporate clients is expected to lead to the expected sharp improvement in Fujitsu's earnings.
